title: Service Supervisor
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


POSITION PURPOSE

The Service Supervisor supports and supervises daily Front End operations to ensure exceptional customer service, efficient checkout operations, accurate cash handling, appropriate staffing, and compliance with company policies and procedures. This position provides direction to Front End associates and helps maintain a welcoming, organized, and customer-focused environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Service & Front End Operations

  • Provide friendly, professional, and efficient customer service.
  • Supervise daily Front End activities and maintain smooth customer flow.
  • Monitor checkout lines and adjust associate coverage based on business needs.
  • Assist customers with questions, concerns, refunds, and other service needs.
  • Promote a positive shopping experience and respond appropriately to customer concerns.
  • Ensure Front End areas remain clean, organized, and customer-ready.

Cash Handling & Checkout

  • Support accurate cash handling and register procedures.
  • Assist with register transactions, overrides, refunds, and other authorized functions.
  • Monitor cash accountability and adherence to established procedures.
  • Assist with balancing registers and completing required Front End documentation.
  • Identify and communicate cash-handling discrepancies to appropriate store leadership.

Team Leadership & Training

  • Assign daily responsibilities and provide direction to Front End associates.
  • Train and support cashiers, courtesy clerks, and other service associates.
  • Reinforce customer-service expectations and Front End standards.
  • Monitor associate workflow, productivity, and completion of assigned responsibilities.
  • Provide coaching and direction when service or operational opportunities are identified.
  • Support appropriate Front End coverage during breaks, lunches, and periods of increased customer traffic.

Safety & Compliance

  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized Front End environment.
  • Ensure associates follow established safety and security procedures.
  • Monitor the Front End for potential hazards and promptly address or report concerns.
  • Follow company policies related to cash handling, customer transactions, and loss prevention.
  • Support compliance with applicable company policies and operational procedures.

Store & Administrative Support

  • Communicate staffing, customer-service, equipment, and operational concerns to store leadership.
  • Assist with opening and closing Front End procedures.
  • Complete required records, reports, and documentation.
  • Support price checks, customer inquiries, and other store operational needs.
  • Coordinate with other departments to resolve customer concerns.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

  • Competitive wages paid weekly
· Access to up to 50% of your earned wages before payday, via our partnership with Stream
  • Associate discounts
  • Health and financial well-being benefits for eligible associates (Medical, Dental, 401k and more!)
  • Time off (vacation, holidays, sick pay). For eligibility requirements please visit myACI Benefits
  • Leaders invested in your training, career growth and development
  • An inclusive work environment with talented colleagues who reflect the communities we serve

POSITION PURPOSE

The Dairy Supervisor oversees the daily operations of the Dairy Department, ensuring products are properly stocked, rotated, merchandised, and maintained according to company standards. Customer Service & Sales

  • Assist customers with locating products and answering product-related questions.
  • Maintain full, clean, organized, and visually appealing dairy displays.
  • Support promotional activity, seasonal merchandising, and featured products.
  • Address customer concerns and escalate issues when appropriate.

Dairy Department Operations

  • Coordinate daily stocking, replenishment, rotation, and merchandising activities.
  • Maintain department standards for product freshness, quality, presentation, and availability.
  • Ensure shelves, displays, coolers, and refrigerated cases remain properly stocked and organized.
  • Monitor product dates and ensure proper rotation using established procedures.

  • Maintain a safe and organized working environment.

Team Leadership & Training

  • Provide coaching and direction when operational or service opportunities are identified.

Administrative & Department Support

  • Assist with monitoring department sales, labor, shrink, and productivity.
  • Coordinate department priorities based on workload and business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


POSITION PURPOSE

The Night Supervisor oversees and coordinates overnight grocery operations to ensure merchandise is received, stocked, rotated, and presented according to company standards. This position provides direction to the night crew while supporting efficient freight processing, inventory control, merchandising, safety, sanitation, and overall store readiness for the following business day.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Night Crew Operations

  • Coordinate and oversee overnight stocking and replenishment activities.
  • Assign freight and stocking responsibilities based on workload and department priorities.
  • Ensure merchandise is stocked accurately, efficiently, and in the appropriate locations.
  • Monitor completion of overnight responsibilities and adjust assignments as needed.
  • Ensure aisles, displays, backroom areas, and sales-floor conditions are ready for customers.
  • Support opening readiness by ensuring assigned overnight work is completed.

Stocking & Merchandising

  • Ensure shelves and displays are properly stocked, faced, organized, and maintained.
  • Follow established merchandising standards, schematics, and product-placement requirements.
  • Ensure products are properly rotated and outdated, damaged, or unsellable merchandise is addressed.
  • Support promotional displays, ad changes, and seasonal merchandising.
  • Maintain accurate shelf conditions and communicate product or inventory concerns to store leadership.

Receiving & Inventory Control

  • Assist with receiving, organizing, and processing incoming merchandise.
  • Ensure freight is properly separated and distributed to appropriate departments.
  • Maintain organized backroom and storage areas.
  • Help minimize shrink through proper product handling, rotation, and inventory-control practices.
  • Communicate shortages, overages, damaged merchandise, or delivery concerns to leadership.

Team Leadership & Training

  • Assign daily responsibilities and provide direction to night crew associates.
  • Train associates on stocking procedures, merchandising standards, safety, sanitation, and department expectations.
  • Monitor associate workflow and completion of assigned responsibilities.
  • Provide coaching and direction when productivity or operational opportunities are identified.
  • Promote teamwork and efficient completion of overnight priorities.
  • Communicate outstanding work and operational concerns to incoming store leadership.

Safety & Sanitation

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment.
  • Ensure aisles and work areas remain clear of unnecessary equipment, debris, and other hazards.
  • Follow established procedures for safe lifting, stocking, and material handling.
  • Ensure associates safely operate pallet jacks, carts, balers, and other authorized equipment.
  • Follow company workplace safety and sanitation requirements.
  • Promptly communicate equipment or safety concerns to store leadership.

Administrative & Store Support

  • Assist with coordinating overnight workload and staffing priorities.
  • Complete required department records, logs, and documentation.
  • Communicate inventory, staffing, delivery, equipment, and operational concerns to store leadership.
  • Support inventory counts and other store operational activities as assigned.
  • Assist with monitoring productivity and completion of overnight workload.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Director, Animal Resources
description:
The Director of Animal Resources Personnel & Operations provides senior-level leadership, strategic oversight, and fiscal accountability for applicable operational and regulatory activities within the Division of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) at the Tulane National Biomedical Research Center (TNBRC). This position ensures that operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and resource optimization are achieved across multiple programs that support the Center’s research mission. The Director oversees approximately 120 full-time employees across major operational components in the Division supporting animal care. This position partners with executive leadership to ensure alignment with institutional goals, NIH grant requirements, and regulatory and accreditation standards. This position oversees multiple managers, assistant managers, supervisors, and technical teams.

The Director of Animal Resources Personnel & Operations will have demonstrated capacity for leadership, employee development, employee performance evaluation, goal-setting, conflict resolution, and workforce training to ensure that operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance are maintained at the highest standards. The position provides mentorship to managers and supervisors within Animal Care and Veterinary Technician Operations to ensure that teams are technically proficient and empowered to solve complex operational challenges.

As an integral member of the Division’s senior leadership team, the Director advises and consults with the TNBRC Chief Veterinary Medical Officer/ Chair of the Division of Veterinary Medicine on matters related to personnel, operations, infrastructure, fiscal planning, and compliance. The role contributes to strategic planning, growth management, and master planning for the Division, and shares responsibility with the CVMO for financial affairs, construction projects, human resources management, and staff development initiatives.

The position requires advanced leadership capability, cross-unit coordination, strategic planning, superior knowledge of federal regulations, and the ability to lead programs that directly impact USDA, AAALAC, and OLAW accreditation.

This position is designated as essential personnel for continuity of operations during emergencies, including storms/natural disasters. If required to work during a closure, the employee must provide accurate and current contact information and is responsible for maintaining communication with TNBRC. Failure to report to work when requested by supervisor or manager will result in disciplinary action as outlined by the Staff Handbook.

Failure to meet established performance standards in the performance of the job duties and responsibilities outlined in this job description (or as otherwise assigned); and/or failure to interact courteously and tactfully with managers, co-workers, customers and/or vendors such that productivity or departmental morale suffers will result in management’s taking the appropriate disciplinary action as outlined in the Staff Handbook.

Employee attendance must meet established work schedules. Faithfulness in coming to work, being on time, planning absences in advance when possible, and calling in when unavoidably detained from reporting for work is an essential requirement of the job.

• Comprehensive leadership and management expertise, including the ability to direct large, diverse teams; oversee managers and supervisors; and develop staff through mentoring, coaching, and performance management.
• Advanced knowledge of organizational operations, human resources management, fiscal planning, and strategic procurement, including budgeting, workforce design, and change management in a research or academic environment.
• Exceptional communication, collaboration, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to influence outcomes, build consensus, and maintain collegial relationships across all organizational levels.
• Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain high-performing and diverse talent, fostering a culture of inclusion, accountability, and professional growth.
• Proven capacity for strategic decision-making and problem-solving, utilizing data-driven analysis, sound judgment, and institutional priorities to guide operational and financial outcomes.
• Specific precautions against and/or be immunized against potentially hazardous agents are required.
• Strong regulatory, compliance, and procurement acumen, including expert understanding of AAALAC, USDA, OLAW, CDC, and NIH requirements and university purchasing policies, with the ability to interpret, apply, and implement complex regulations and supply-chain controls to ensure accreditation, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation.
• Ability to design, implement, and evaluate operational processes, quality-assurance programs, and continuous-improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, safety, and compliance across facilities and programs.
• Proficiency in enterprise systems and digital platforms used for financial management, procurement, maintenance tracking, and health-records administration (e.g., LabKey, Oracle, CMMS), and demonstrated ability to lead system-implementation and optimization projects.
• Must participate in drug and alcohol program and be in compliance with TNBRC drug and alcohol policy.
• The TNBRC maintains biosafety level 3 facilities and performs work on diverse infectious agents, many of which can cause serious disease in humans if standard operating procedures, including use of appropriate personal protective equipment, are not followed. Depending on agent-specific risk assessments, individuals may be offered, or in some cases required, to have vaccinations against the relevant agents. If this position is assigned to work in ABSL3 containment areas, there will be additional minimum requirements including some or all of the following:
a. Must pass a US Department of Justice Security Risk Assessment for access to select biological agents and toxins.
b. Ability to perform job duties while wearing respiratory protection.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in Animal Science, Biological Science, Management, Public Health, Business Administration, Industrial Psychology, or a related degree.
• A minimum of five years of progressive management and/or operations experience is required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Master’s degree in Biological Sciences, Veterinary or Animal Sciences, Management, Public Health, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
• Ten years of progressive management and/or operations experience.
• Professional certification through AALAS (ALAT, LAT, LATG, and/or CMAR), and completion of ILAM or equivalent advanced leadership programs are highly desirable.
• Extensive knowledge of nonhuman primate colony management and breeding programs within ABSL-2 and ABSL-3 containment environments, including operational oversight of large, complex populations.
• Demonstrated experience in a research or academic institution utilizing animals in research, with responsibility for compliance oversight, operational management, and collaboration among veterinary, research, and administrative units.
• Comprehensive understanding of animal welfare regulations, policies, and accreditation standards, including USDA, OLAW, PHS Policy, and AAALAC International requirements.
• Knowledge of Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) functions, policies, and reporting requirements, with the ability to integrate regulatory expectations into operational systems and staff training programs.
• Experience leading or contributing to strategic planning, policy development, and capital project management related to research operations, animal welfare, and compliance oversight is strongly preferred.

description:
Meio Oficial de Marcenaria APS Santa Marcelina - Edital 260/2026

Objetivos do Processo Seletivo

  • Captação de Profissionais alinhados aos requisitos e ao perfil de competências do cargo.

Informações sobre o Processo Seletivo

  • Pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas nesse processo seletivo.
  • Somente serão admitidos candidatos com exame médico com parecer de apto para o cargo.
  • Durante e após o processo seletivo é esperado que os candidatos mantenham atitudes condizentes com os valores, preceitos éticos e de convivência institucionais e com as exigências para o cargo.
  • Os candidatos serão convocados de acordo com o seu perfil de competência alinhado à vaga disponível.
  • Os candidatos aprovados permanecerão em Cadastro Reserva por 12 (doze) meses contados a partir da data de publicação do resultado. Terão duas oportunidades de análise de vaga e havendo recusa em ambas, serão excluídos do Cadastro Reserva.


Principais Atribuições no Cargo

  • Cumprir com o contrato de trabalho, respeitando as políticas, diretrizes e protocolos institucionais;
  • Zelar pela sua imagem profissional projetada respeitando a identidade, missão, visão e valores institucionais, bem como manter atitude segura e hábitos saudáveis zelando pelo equilíbrio e bem-estar;
  • Realizar tratativas dos processos de trabalho com a liderança da área para discussão das decisões e alinhamento das ações;
  • Manter a comunicação clara, objetiva e afável com toda a equipe e demais profissionais da Instituição, mediando conflitos e promovendo convivência respeitosa e livre de assédio, dano moral ou desrespeito à diversidade;
  • Executar atividades conforme projetos, especificações técnicas, procedimentos e orientações estabelecidas;
  • Registrar as atividades executadas por meio de ordens de serviço, documentos, sistemas ou outros meios disponibilizados pela instituição;
  • Auxiliar o marceneiro na execução de suas tarefas;
  • Desmontar, transportar, polir móveis, equipamentos ou utensílios de madeira;
  • Substituir peças danificadas ou desgastadas conforme necessidade;
  • Efetuar manutenção preventiva;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes de manutenção e operação conforme necessidade da instituição;
  • Cumprir as normas de segurança, os procedimentos internos e a legislação aplicável, zelando pela qualidade e integridade das atividades realizadas;
  • Zelar pelo patrimônio, estrutura, equipamentos, materiais e ambiente de trabalho;
  • Avaliar anualmente o seu desempenho em instrumento formal institucional junto com o seu superior imediato;
  • Realizar os exames periódicos na Medicina do Trabalho, apresentando a carteira de vacinação e cumprir com a normativa da Medicina do Trabalho vigente;
  • Atender as demais demandas do processo de trabalho, conforme políticas, protocolos, manuais, normativas e regimentos institucionais.

Dados da vagas

  • Os dados referentes a salário e demais condições serão comunicados aos candidatos convocados ao longo do processo seletivo.
  • Benefícios: Vale transporte, Vale alimentação e Vale Refeição.
  • Carga Horária: 220h.
  • Escala: Seg a Sex.

Requisitos exigidos para participação neste Processo Seletivo

  • Ensino Fundamental completo;
  • Desejável Ensino Médio;
  • Certificado de Curso em Marcenaria ou áreas afins;
  • Desejável Carteira Nacional de Habilitação categoria B com no mínimo um ano de experiência em condução de veículo de passeio;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área.

Etapas do Processo de Avaliação: todas eliminatórias e classificatórias.

• Análise do currículo;

• Entrevista em Grupo;

• Entrevista com Gestor.

Observação: em todas as etapas, o candidato deverá comparecer com documento de identificação.

Cronograma Divulgação do Edital:

Cadastrar o currículo no período de 01/10/2026 à 16/10/2026, no último dia até às 12h00. Haverá convocação por e-mail e telefone.

Divulgação do Resultado Final desse processo seletivo: 03/11/2026, até às 17h00. As divulgações ocorrerão no site institucional contendo o nome completo dos candidatos aprovados. Sites institucional: www.aps.santamarcelina.org.
